question: How many countries has the gdp per capita lower than the world in 2019?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) AS countries_below_world_gdp_per_capita_2019 FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year = 2019 AND gdp_per_capita < ( SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita) FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year = 2019 ) LIMIT 50;
answer: In 2019, there were **182 countries** whose GDP per capita was lower than the world average.
